description: Conversion of part of the existing flat roof to a terrace space, enabled by the extension of the existing cores.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Existing Plans: SH648-MSL-XX-XXX-DR-A-PL1000; SH648-MSL-XX-R01-DR-A-PL1008; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1010;SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1011;SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1012; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1013; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1014; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1015; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1108; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1110; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1111; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1112; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1113

Proposed Plans: SH648-MSL-XX-R01-DR-A-PL1208 Rev:PL02; SH648-MSL-XX-R02-DR-A-PL1209 Rev:PL02; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR A PL1210_PL04; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1211_PL04; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1212_PL04; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1213_PL02; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1215_PL02; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1216 PL:01; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1217 PL-02; SH648-MSL-XX-ZZ-DR-A-PL1291_PL02; SH648-MSL-XX-R01-DR-A-PL1292 Rev:PL02; SH648-MSL-XX-R01-DR-A-PL1293 Rev:PL01.

Document: Covering Letter; Design and Access Statement; Management Plan dated 15/01/2025. 

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The use of the terraces hereby permitted shall not be carried out outside the 
following times: 08:00 to 20:00 Mondays to Fridays. It shall not be used at all on the weekends and on bank holidays. 

Reason:To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of Policies  A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 5 - No music shall be played on the terraces hereby permitted in such a way as to be audible within any adjoining premises or on the adjoining highway. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area 
generally in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, D1, A1, A4 and DM1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017
Condition : 6 - The roof terrace at hereby approved shall be operated at all times in full accordance with the details submitted and approved in the Management Plan dated 15/01/2026. No use of the roof terrace shall take place other than in compliance with the approved details.

Reason: To ensure the roof terrace is managed appropriately and to safeguard the amenities of adjoining premises and the area generally, in accordance with the requirements of Policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
